column1: # Cruis'n USA motor-byte trace: 62 s of real driving on the rig
# captured 2026-09-04 with vunit.exe v0.3.7 (mvffb built-in FFB).
# This is the INPUT to the conditioning chain
# the arcade code wrote to WHLCTLZ
# what MAME's output port carries (0..255); 'byte' is int8_t(raw)
# is what midv_ffb_write actually receives. MIDV_FFB_CLAMP and
# MIDV_FFB_SLEW were both off for this capture
